description: REST API contract for syncing linked RFID tags with ERP stock. Send this to Posh RFID developers for review.

endpoints_posh_calls_kc.description: Posh RFID gun polls linked in-stock items for this store
Health check — verify credentials before full sync

endpoints_we_call.when: User links an RFID tag to a barcode in ERP
Item sold, stock deleted, tag unlinked, or barcode removed from RFID
Manual full sync from ERP Hardware page
endpoints_we_call.notes: Replaces or merges full in-stock RFID inventory for the store. Items not in the list should be removed from the gun.

erp_lifecycle_events: RFID tag linked to barcode → POST link
Bill saved (sold) → POST unlink for each sold tagged piece
Batch delete → POST unlink for each tagged piece
Manual sync button → POST sync with all in_stock + rfid_tag rows
questions_for_posh_developer: Confirm final base URL and API version path
Confirm auth scheme (Bearer vs X-Api-Key only)
Does sync replace entire store inventory or upsert only?
How should we handle duplicate rfid_tag across stores?
Webhook support for gun-side changes back to ERP?
Sandbox/test store ID and sample credentials
Expected response format and error codes
